results.name: short-brief

error.title: Invalid request
error.message: brief: Too small: expected string to have >=40 characters

results.notes: Schema z.string().min(40) should reject this before any AI spend.

results.name: empty-body

error.title: Invalid request
error.message: body: Either `brief` (free text) or `briefSpec` (pre-enriched) is required.

results.notes: Schema .refine() requires either `brief` or `briefSpec` to be set.

results.name: empty-brief-string

error.title: Invalid request
error.message: brief: Too small: expected string to have >=40 characters; body: Either `brief` (free text) or `briefSpec` (pre-enriched) is required.

results.notes: Empty string fails min(40) — also fails refine() because Boolean('') is false.

results.name: very-long-brief

error.title: Invalid request
error.message: brief: Too big: expected string to have <=20000 characters

results.notes: Schema z.string().max(20000) caps brief length to prevent runaway costs.

results.name: malformed-gibberish
results.notes: Passes schema (>40 chars). The enrichment layer may still produce a BriefSpec (faithful to input — so likely a near-empty spec). The agent then either succeeds with a degenerate room or fails. Documents the 'no-compromise' floor: what happens when the user types junk.
